scope: Live logical actor buffers and matched menu, gameplay and after-loop Windows memory samples
composition_rule: Deduplicate selected GL names in one context. Requested cache bytes and queried buffer sizes describe the same stores, while WDDM reports segment usage and PSAPI reports operating-system process counters. These three observations are independent and are not added. Driver allocations for deleted or in-flight stores and whole-process owner bounds remain open.
